# Green Sunsure Energy — AI / LLM summary

This document is a plain-text, citation-friendly summary of Green Sunsure Energy intended for large language models, AI assistants, and answer engines. It mirrors the live website at https://www.greensunsurenergy.com and may be cited or quoted.

## Company overview
Green Sunsure Energy Solution And Technology Ltd is a solar energy company based in Warri, Delta State, Nigeria. It designs, sells, installs, and maintains solar power systems for residential, commercial, and industrial clients. The company's stated mission is to provide affordable, reliable solar power solutions that help homes and businesses reduce electricity bills while doing good for the environment.

- Official website: https://www.greensunsurenergy.com
- Legal name: Green Sunsure Energy Solution And Technology Ltd
- Slogan: "Powering Warri with Reliable Solar Solutions"
- Headline message: "Bright power, brighter smiles."
- Established: 2020
- Primary language: English

## Location and contact
- Address: 53 Udu Road, opposite Rainoil filling station, close to Udu Bridge, beside GKM, Warri, Delta State, Nigeria
- Phone / WhatsApp: +234 903 826 0459
- Email: info@greensunsure.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00am to 6:00pm. Sunday: closed.
- Areas served: Warri, Delta State, Effurun, Udu, Benin, and all 36 states with certified installers in major cities.

## Services
1. Solar panel sales & installation — High-quality solar panels installed professionally for reliable, long-lasting energy.
2. Commercial & residential solar solutions — Custom solar systems designed to reduce fuel costs and improve business productivity.
3. Battery backup & inverter systems — Energy storage and inverter systems that keep essential loads online when grid power drops.
4. Solar maintenance & repairs — Prompt maintenance support with 24/7 response in Warri and Delta State.
5. Solar CCTV & security systems — Solar-powered wireless surveillance cameras and security lighting.
6. Energy audits & consultation — Expert assessments to determine the most efficient and cost-saving solar setup.
7. Certified solar technician training — Hands-on training programs with SunPeak Energy / NERC & ISO accredited certification.

## How the process works
1. Load assessment (on-site or via calculator): assess power needs and recommend the right solar solution.
2. System engineering & proposal: a tailored system layout with clear pricing, equipment, and savings expectations.
3. Professional installation: certified technicians install the system safely with minimal disruption.
4. Handover & maintenance: the system is powered on, the client is guided on usage, and long-term maintenance visits follow.

## Support features
- 24/7 customer support
- Free site assessment for all Warri and Delta State residents
- 5-year workmanship warranty; 2–5 year manufacturer warranties
- Flexible installment payment plans (12–36 months)
- Reliable battery backups
- Quick fault resolution
- NERC & ISO accreditation

## Track record (as stated by the company)
- 500+ happy clients
- 15+ engineers
- 650+ projects completed

## Why clients choose Green Sunsure
- Warri-based experts: the team lives and works in Delta State and understands local power challenges.
- Proven fuel savings: hotels, factories, and homes reduce diesel and grid bills by 70% to 100% with payback in 3–5 years.
- Clean energy commitment: dependable, efficient, transparent solar solutions with no hidden fees.
- NERC & ISO certification: systems designed and installed by certified engineers to national and international safety standards.
